headline: Healthy Growth; Capacity to Unlock Demand

highlights: Key Points  In-line operating performance; margins moderate: Eicher Motors reported a steady 2QFY27, with revenue rising 20.3% YoY to Rs74.2bn, in line with NBIE (+0.3%) and ahead of consensus (+4.5%), driven by Royal Enfield volumes of 376,722 units (+15.2% YoY).
Gross margin contracted by 171bps YoY to 42.0% amid commodity inflation, though it improved by 48bps QoQ.
EBITDA grew 16.4% YoY to Rs17.6bn, in line with NBIE and consensus, while EBITDA margin moderated to 23.7% (-79bps YoY).

Adjusted PAT rose 14.9% YoY to Rs15.7bn, 4.9% below NBIE but 8.3% ahead of consensus, aided by a 37.9% YoY increase in VECV profit share.  Outlook: Management remains constructive on 2HFY27, noting that festive season retail was limited only by supply.
valuation: The company has taken four price hikes this year, including ~0.7% in October, to offset commodity inflation, though input cost volatility and geopolitical uncertainties remain near-term risks.  Valuation: We expect volumes/revenue/EBITDA to grow at 13%/17%/16% CAGR over FY26–28E, driven by premiumisation, strong domestic demand, export growth, and capacity expansion.

We maintain BUY with a TP of Rs9,503 (previous Rs8,888), valuing the standalone business at 32.5x Sep-28E EPS and VECV at 11x Sep-28E EV/EBITDA. 2QFY27 results: Eicher Motors reported a steady 2QFY27 performance, with consolidated revenue rising 20.3% YoY (+11.9% QoQ) to Rs74.2bn, in line with NBIE estimates (+0.3%) and 4.5% ahead of consensus.

CMP: Rs7,650 | Target Price (TP): Rs9,503 | Upside: 24% November 16, 2026 Institutional Equities Eicher Motors 2 VECV 2QFY27 results update: VECV delivered a strong 2QFY27, with volumes rising 28.2% YoY to 28,071 units on broad-based growth across trucks, buses, engineering components, and power solutions (1HFY27: 52,886 units, +21.5% YoY).
